correctness.rationale: At length four there are 96 two-GC words and 72 unbordered candidates. Disjoint first-/last-letter sets bound the candidate counts; endpoint sizes (1,3) and (3,1) lose at least two self-bordered words and mixed (2,2) loses two bordered words and at least one from each of three disjoint incompatible pairs, leaving at most 19. Uniform AT-to-GC or GC-to-AT endpoints separate 16 compatible LLRR words from LRLR words, the latter corresponding to arcs between four two-letter blocks with disjoint initial and terminal vertex sets. At most 2*2=4 arcs; equality forces a complete bipartite directed rectangle, six choices of a two-element prefix block set for each endpoint orientation. Thus exactly twelve size-20 codes. Symbol relabeling and word reversal have orbit sizes 4 and 8. A fresh independent exact maximum-clique enumeration on all 72 unbordered balanced words found optimum 20 and precisely the same twelve codes (424 search nodes); this is a finite *exhaustive* domain of size four, not an extrapolation.
